thresholds.label: RSI(14) at or below
thresholds.means: the daily Relative Strength Index, the line most desks call oversold

thresholds.label: RSI(14) at or above
thresholds.means: the same line on the other side, called overbought

thresholds.label: distance from the 200-day, in %
thresholds.means: 0 means the average itself; raise it to ask for names clearly above their long trend line

thresholds.label: distance from the 50-day, in %
thresholds.means: the same dial on the medium trend line

thresholds.label: branch breadth at or above
thresholds.means: share of the branch's names above their own 200-day average; 80% is the usual strong reading

thresholds.label: branch breadth at or below
thresholds.means: the same measure at the weak end

thresholds.label: Williams %R at or below
thresholds.means: a second oversold line, on a scale that runs 0 to -100

thresholds.label: 50-day over 200-day (no dial)
thresholds.means: the crossing traders call golden (above) or death (below); it is a state, not a number to set
